definitions.explanation: an aircraft or vehicle that operates without a human pilot on board

examples.japanese: {無人機|むじんき}が{空|そら}を{飛|と}んでいる。
examples.english: A drone is flying in the sky.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}{現場|げんば}で{無人機|むじんき}が{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: Drones are playing an active role at disaster sites.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{無人機|むじんき}の{飛行|ひこう}に{関|かん}する{新|あたら}しい{規制|きせい}を{導入|どうにゅう}した。
examples.english: The government introduced new regulations regarding drone flights.

notes:
Refers to any unmanned aircraft, from small consumer drones to large military vehicles. Composed of {無人|むじん} (unmanned) + {機|き} (machine, aircraft). The loanword ドローン is more common in casual conversation, while {無人機|むじんき} appears more frequently in news, government documents, and formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無人機|むじんき}による{攻撃|こうげき} — drone attack/strike
- {無人機|むじんき}の{飛行|ひこう} — drone flight
- {無人機|むじんき}{規制|きせい} — drone regulations
- {小型|こがた}{無人機|むじんき} — small unmanned aircraft
- {軍事用|ぐんじよう}{無人機|むじんき} — military drone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ドローン — drone (loanword, more casual and widely used in everyday speech)
- {無人|むじん}{航空機|こうくうき} — unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV; formal/technical synonym)
- {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ} — remote control (the method of operating drones)
